invariants.rationale: When clamp is true, amountX is clamped within limits depending on overscrollX.
When clamp is true, amountY is clamped within limits depending on overscrollY.

invariants.expression: !clamp || (MathUtils.clamp(amountX, (overscrollX ? -overscrollDistance : 0), (overscrollX ? maxX + overscrollDistance : maxX)) == (overscrollX ? MathUtils.clamp(amountX, -overscrollDistance, maxX + overscrollDistance) : MathUtils.clamp(amountX, 0, maxX)))
invariants.rationale: Clamping to the correct boundaries depending on overscrollX.

invariants.expression: !clamp || (MathUtils.clamp(amountY, (overscrollY ? -overscrollDistance : 0), (overscrollY ? maxY + overscrollDistance : maxY)) == (overscrollY ? MathUtils.clamp(amountY, -overscrollDistance, maxY + overscrollDistance) : MathUtils.clamp(amountY, 0, maxY)))
invariants.rationale: Clamping to the correct boundaries depending on overscrollY.
Maximum scroll values are likely non-negative when clamp is true.
